description: Declaration of the National Legal Aid Day in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Legal Aid Commission of Sri Lanka was established under the Legal Aid Act No.27 of 1978 with the objective of facilitating access to justice for all citizens, including vulnerable groups and marginalized persons. The Commission makes a significant contribution to the protection of fundamental rights, strengthening the rule of law and promoting access to justice through the provision of legal aid services and promotion of legal awareness. The appropriateness of declaring a National Legal Aid Day has been identified with the objective of enhancing public awareness of legal rights and remedies, facilitating a national dialogue on law enforcement and enhancing public understanding of the importance of legal aid services. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to declare 06th July, the date of the enactment of the Legal Aid Act, No.27 of 1978, as the 'National Legal Aid Day in Sri Lanka' was approved by the Cabinet.
